# Fatik Rahman

> Personal brand website of Fatik Rahman — an Indian entrepreneur, Top Rated Plus
> Upwork Freelancer, Upwork Coach, Freelancing Mentor, Web Developer, and Digital
> Business Strategist with nearly eight years of practical experience.

## Who is Fatik Rahman

- Top Rated Plus freelancer on Upwork; entered the platform in 2023 after years of direct client work.
- Upwork Coach and Freelancing Mentor helping aspiring freelancers with profile positioning,
  proposal writing, client acquisition, pricing, and long-term career planning.
- Web developer and digital business strategist serving startups, small businesses,
  entrepreneurs, and established organisations.
- Works with clients across India, the United States, Europe, and the United Arab Emirates.

## Background

- Born 28 December 2000; Indian nationality.
- Diploma Engineering, Aligarh Muslim University (2016–2019).
- Joined APPOINTPANDA as an intern in January 2019 while completing his diploma.
- Built a freelancing career from Aligarh across major Indian cities, then internationally.
- B.Sc. Computer Engineering, Vistula University, Warsaw, Poland (2021–2025).
- Today: freelancer, coach, mentor, entrepreneur, and team builder.

## Services

- Upwork coaching
- Freelancing mentorship
- Web development
- Client acquisition
- Digital business strategy
- Team and project management
